racksFullQuotes.text: 🍲 Maya cooked for the haven — meals stretched. The racks are already full (12,054 kcal kept — more than the haven can eat before it turns), so Maya left the fresh pile for tonight's dinner instead of smoking it onto the rot pile.

workedQuoteFirst.text: 🍲 Andre cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Andre worked the smoke racks too — 1 batch preserved (~400 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
